seo.title: Michigan & Metro Detroit Sports Photographer | Garrett Erickson
seo.description: Metro Detroit sports photographer Garrett Erickson shoots high school football, soccer, tennis, volleyball and hockey across Michigan. Team, individual and game-day shoots. Get a free quote.

sections.label: About
sections.heading: I'm Garrett Erickson, a Michigan sports photographer covering high school football, soccer, tennis and volleyball across Metro Detroit.
paragraphs: Most of my work happens on the sideline: varsity and JV football under the lights at Detroit Country Day, soccer against Cranbrook and Cass Tech, tennis match days at Seaholm and Liggett, and volleyball in the gym. I shoot the play, the huddle and the bench, so every athlete has photographs worth keeping.

Away from the field I shoot architecture and street, including car meets along Woodward and a stretch of work made in New York. I care about light, structure, and the moment a scene resolves into something worth keeping.
I shoot whole teams and individual athletes, and I turn work around fast: individual sessions are guaranteed back within 24 hours.

sections.label: Sports photography
sections.heading: Sports photography in Michigan

cards.title: Football
cards.text: Varsity and JV games and practices: the snap, the run after the catch, the sideline and the post-game huddle.

cards.title: Soccer
cards.text: Varsity and JV soccer: headers, saves, celebrations and the team talk at half time.

cards.title: Tennis
cards.text: Match days and practices, singles and doubles: the serve toss, the stretch for a wide ball, the handshake at the net.

cards.title: Volleyball
cards.text: Kills, digs, serves and the whole bench on its feet.

cards.title: Teams & athletes
cards.text: Whole-roster shoots with a team photo and a gallery for every athlete, or a one-on-one session for senior posts, recruiting profiles and social media.

cards.title: Any other sport
cards.text: Basketball, hockey, lacrosse, baseball, softball, swimming, track and field, and cross country, plus car meets and other events. If it happens in Michigan, ask.

sections.area: Based in Metro Detroit. I regularly shoot in Detroit, Birmingham, Bloomfield Hills, Beverly Hills, Royal Oak, Troy, Southfield, Grosse Pointe and Dearborn, across Oakland, Wayne and Macomb counties, and anywhere else in Michigan on request.

items.q: How much does a sports photographer cost in Michigan?
items.a: Every shoot is quoted to fit: the price depends on the sport, how many athletes, how long, and where. Fill in the [quote form](#quote) and I'll email you a price. Quotes are free, with no obligation.

items.q: How fast will I get my photos?
items.a: Individual sessions are guaranteed back within 24 hours, and events within 48 hours. If you need photos the same day, say so in your quote request.

items.q: Which schools and areas do you cover?
items.a: I'm based in Metro Detroit and have shot games at Detroit Country Day, Seaholm, Cranbrook, Liggett, Cass Tech, Divine Child, Redford and Holt. I'll travel anywhere in Michigan. See photos from every team game on the [game photos page](games/).
Yes. A team shoot covers the whole roster in one session, includes a team photograph, and gives every athlete their own gallery of action and individual frames.

items.q: Can I post the photos on Instagram or use them for recruiting?
items.a: Yes. Personal and social use is included with every session, which covers Instagram, recruiting profiles and highlight reels. Commercial use is available on request.

items.q: What if I want a photo of my child taken down?
items.a: Open the photograph in the portfolio and press **Request removal**. You don't have to explain why, and I'll take it down.

Send a request through the [quote form](#quote) and I'll reply with a price and to confirm the date. You can also email [garrettoscarerickson@gmail.com](mailto:garrettoscarerickson@gmail.com) or DM [@shot_by_ge](https://www.instagram.com/shot_by_ge) on Instagram.
